caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a slant-front desk or secretary desk, colored in various shades of brown with visible wood grain texture. The desk features a slanted writing surface on the upper portion, which is closed, with a metal handle in the center of the slant-front panel. Below the writing surface, there are three horizontal drawers, each fitted with two decorative metal handles that appear to be dark in color, possibly black or dark gray. The two topmost corners of the front face of the desk have small locks or metal fixtures where the writing surface panel meets the sides. The desk has short, bracket feet on each corner, and the entire piece is well defined with fine line work to indicate shadow and depth. The background is plain, off-white, with some slight discoloration or marking, and there is a double-lined border around the desk. The name "BOGENBARK" is lightly inscribed in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Child's Desk
